title: Peroral Endoscopic Myotomy for the Treatment of Achalasia
official: Peroral Endoscopic Myotomy for the Treatment of Achalasia: A Single-center Registry
summary: There will be a retrospective chart review for patients who underwent endoscopic procedures and POEM from 06/2016 - 01/2019 \& a prospective chart review will be performed for patients who will undergo endoscopic procedures and POEM from 02/2019 - 06/2021
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Any discharged patient who has undergone clinically indicated and/or standard of care POEM for the treatment of Achalasia from 6/2016 to 6/2021.
* Above or equal to 18 years of age

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any patient who has not undergone POEM for the treatment of Achalasia.
* Below 18 years of age
